text_block_list.text:
You were so focused, your face was
practically
planted right onto the glass. I
could tell from
back here.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
I don't know how in the world you
managed to
maintain your concentration
in such a raucous
environment. Perhaps
you can teach me later.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер
